assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE finished high-fidelity ideal in-game battle skill-selection UI screenshot for the Chinese fantasy roguelike DiceLand.
Primary request: redesign the plain existing battle skill page into a beautiful, practical, polished interface while preserving its real functions and actual data. Deliver one coherent finished game screenshot, not a presentation sheet, annotated wireframe, website, or before-and-after.

Input roles:
Image 1 is the EXISTING BATTLE SKILL PAGE, a context, content and functional reference. Replace the crude central translucent brown popup with the redesigned skill window. Preserve the recognizable sunlit forest ruins battlefield, left-side young swordsman, right-side blue crystal creatures, speed hexagons and connecting curves behind the modal. The background top-left HUD says "能量 4 / 10" and the top-center plaque says "第 1 回合".
Image 2 is the approved DiceLand ITEM DETAIL DESIGN, a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Reuse its restrained antique gold/brass edging, near-opaque deep forest-green reading surfaces, subtly carved dark oak, small teal inset gems and ivy concentrated at corners. Do NOT copy its item crystal, victory panel, reward contents, labels or item-detail window.

Composition: wide landscape, keep the approximately 2.17:1 aspect ratio of Image 1, ideally 2640 x 1216. Keep the full outer game view with margins. A centered modal around 76% of the screen width and 80% of the height sits below the top HUD. Darken and slightly soften the battlefield behind it. The modal is solid enough that underlying characters, lines and lettering NEVER bleed through the content. Clear panel silhouette, soft realistic UI shadow, fine double brass rails, tasteful wood bevels, sparse ivy at upper-left and lower-right, tiny jewel in the title crest. All ornament stays outside text and controls.

Typography and finish: warm ivory Chinese body text, handsome warm-gold Chinese headers, clean readable Chinese glyphs, large text and generous internal margins. Use a more decorative Chinese face only on short headings, a clean substantial face for body and numbers. Premium painterly fantasy game UI matching the supplied style, tactile controlled materials, disciplined information hierarchy, refined thin dividers, no heavy bloom. Attack ranges in muted coral red, defense accent blue, energy accent cyan, selected state gold with a deep teal surface. Avoid a huge saturated yellow selected rectangle or unstructured text dump. Do not fill blank space with invented art or lore.

HEADER:
A compact centered ornate title plaque reading exactly "武器技能", with a clearly accessible square gilded "×" close control at the top-right.
Within the panel beneath the title, a tidy left-aligned identity line "Chara · 新手木剑", and a smaller right-side contextual line "当前技能：横砍". A slim gold horizontal divider separates the header from content. Keep actor name and weapon visually distinct, with no debug bracket string.
Content consists of TWO aligned zones, LEFT about 29%, RIGHT about 71%, separated by a fine brass vertical rule. Footer below both.

LEFT: section heading "可用技能"; exactly THREE vertically stacked generous skill cards in source order, with consistent left padding and tiny simple functional sword or shield glyphs rather than lavish invented illustrations.
Card 1: "挥砍"; "能耗 0"; small supplementary line "攻击骰 2 ~ 3".
Card 2: "横砍"; "能耗 3"; small supplementary line "攻击骰 2 ~ 4"; a compact clearly readable check badge "已装备". THIS is the current selected card: deep teal-green body, bright controlled gold keyline, subtle gold corner emphasis, warm ivory text. Keep the selected check mark and label separate from the name. It must feel clickable.
Card 3: "格挡"; "能耗 0"; small supplementary line "防御骰 1 ~ 2", shield glyph, cool-blue secondary range.
Cards 1 and 3 are available, not disabled. The current screenshot has enough energy. No invented fourth card, no fake unavailable skill, no fabricated counters or rarity ranks. Leave modest breathing space beneath the short list, do not enlarge the cards to consume all the remaining height. Skill clicking directly switches the selected skill; do not introduce an equip/confirm/apply workflow.

RIGHT: actual CURRENT SKILL detail, well organized instead of one big paragraph:
- Prominent skill name "横砍", with a small understated status badge "当前技能".
- Under it a horizontal row of compact metadata chips reading exactly "攻击", "能耗 3", "骰子数 1". Use a modest attack/sword glyph, a little energy glyph and one dice glyph. No skill rarity, levels, damage-total calculation, power rating, cooldown, target selector or upgrade action.
- A handsome readable dice-detail card beneath. Heading "第 1 攻击骰"; a small red attack die emblem, and large coral-red power range "2 ~ 4" with a subtle label "威力范围". This is a DICE RANGE, not total damage, so never write damage 2-4.
- Beneath a fine internal divider, an inset clause section with the heading "词条". The exact actual rule is "【命中时】对 所有目标 造成 1 点伤害". Render the trigger "【命中时】" as a warm gold small tag; emphasize "所有目标" in muted cyan and the numeral "1" in coral. Allow natural line wrapping, keep comfortable type size. Keep the clause visually linked to the first attack die. Do not change this effect into only one selected enemy or invent a stronger effect.
- Beneath the dice card, a compact description section headed "描述" and the exact honest empty-description text "暂无描述。". Keep it subdued but legible; do NOT invent flavor text for this skill.
- The detail area is designed to vertically scroll for real multi-dice/long-rule content in other states, with a stable header and footer. This ONE short real example fits fully, so do not fabricate more rules or display a misleading scrollbar implying hidden content.

FOOTER:
Separate by a slim brass rule. At bottom-left a small legible instruction "点击技能即切换". At bottom-right a medium clear warm parchment-gold button reading "关闭". Both this button and the top-right × close the same modal. They are closing controls, NOT battle execution or confirmation.
No extra tabs, filters, search, inventory, talent nodes, learn, upgrade, sell, reset, confirm, apply, equipment swap, keybinding hints or invented gameplay controls.

Functional invariants: selected skill stays 横砍, exactly three skills, their costs 0/3/0, one attack die 2~4, one on-hit effect dealing 1 to all targets, empty skill description, source actor Chara and source weapon 新手木剑. Global round and energy match Image 1. The battlefield remains recognizable only around the modal, not visible through foreground text. All specified foreground Chinese text must be correct and comfortably readable. No annotation arrows, watermark, logos, external device frame, added English headings, numbered design notes or duplicate windows. Produce a visually balanced, immediately implementable premium fantasy skill-selection page.

assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE finished high-fidelity MULTI-DICE state of the DiceLand in-battle skill selection page.
Primary request: demonstrate that the approved forest-style skill window works for multiple sequential dice, different ranges, per-die clauses, cross-die synergies and overflowing long descriptions. Use ONLY the following real project data. This is another state of the same page, not a new game system or an annotated design presentation.

Input roles:
Image 1 is the newly generated approved single-die page, a STYLE AND LAYOUT reference. Keep its beautiful deep forest green, slim beveled brass, dark oak title plaque, tiny teal gems, restrained ivy corners, warm ivory text, crisp readable Chinese, gold selected card and overall in-game composition. Replace the content with the real multi-dice example below. Do NOT retain Chara's wooden sword name or 横砍 contents.
Image 2 is the original battlefield screenshot, a BACKGROUND CONTEXT reference only. Retain the recognizable forest ruins, left swordsman, right blue creatures, outer HUD and connecting battle curves under a dark translucent backdrop. The foreground panel content is near-opaque.

Canvas: wide landscape about 2.17:1, matching Image 1. One centered modal about 76-80 percent of the image width and 82 percent of the height. Keep top-left global HUD "能量 4 / 10" and top-center "第 1 回合" visible above. Foreground has a clear frame and disciplined spacing. No device, website, watermark, annotations or design notes.

Same page header and footer:
Centered title plaque "武器技能", gilded square top-right "×" close control.
Identity at upper left inside panel: "Chara · 烬冠剑". Upper-right context "当前技能：冠焰裁断".
Two zones below: left 29 percent, right 71 percent, fine vertical gold divider.
Fixed footer at bottom with small "点击技能即切换" on the left, and a clear parchment-gold "关闭" button on the right.
These fixed headers and closing controls never scroll away.

LEFT: heading "可用技能"; exactly FOUR tidy vertically stacked cards:
1. "掠火斩", "能耗 0", tiny attack sword glyph.
2. "压焰刺", "能耗 2", tiny attack sword glyph.
3. "回烬守势", "能耗 1", tiny blue defense shield glyph.
4. "冠焰裁断", "能耗 4", tiny attack sword glyph, compact gold check badge "已装备". This is selected: deep teal-green with restrained luminous gold keyline, not a large yellow block.
Keep names readable and controls aligned. All four are available for this illustrative 4-energy state. Do not fabricate additional skills, ranks, cooldowns or disabled reasons. No per-skill invented illustrations.

RIGHT HEADER, fixed above its scrollable content:
Prominent skill name "冠焰裁断" with small "当前技能" badge.
Compact metadata "攻击", "能耗 4", "骰子数 2".
Directly below, a compact horizontal DICE OVERVIEW strip containing exactly TWO numbered chips in execution order from left to right:
"1 · 攻击 3 ~ 6" and "2 · 攻击 2 ~ 4".
Use coral red range values and a small red attack die/sword icon. These are overview navigation anchors, not rolls, equipped slots, independent skills or random results. Keep both dice always visible. Do not display a total damage, combined range, fake conditional upgraded range or a +2 result as guaranteed.
Below this strip, a clear scrollable detail viewport with a fine gold scrollbar at its right, currently at top with enough thumb travel to show that the long description continues below. The footer must be physically outside the scroll viewport.

RIGHT BODY: two STACKED independent dice cards, full width, rather than shrinking type to place full rules side by side. Both dice headers and all mechanical clauses fit fully in this screenshot. A natural readable two-line wrap is preferred over tiny text.
DICE CARD 1:
Heading "第 1 攻击骰", small red dice emblem, clear range "3 ~ 6".
Below an internal divider, this exact clause:
"【命中时】使该技能的下一个骰子威力 +2"
Gold trigger tag, coral "+2". Keep the phrase "下一个骰子" explicit to express the real cross-die relation. The second die base range remains 2~4 because the first hit is conditional.
DICE CARD 2:
Heading "第 2 攻击骰", small red dice emblem, clear range "2 ~ 4".
Below an internal divider, these TWO real rules as separate readable clauses:
"【命中时】若目标燃烧不少于 4 层，对当前目标额外造成 4 点伤害"
"【全部攻击段命中时】使当前目标获得 2 层燃烧"
Render triggers warm gold, "当前目标" muted cyan, and numeric values and "燃烧" in restrained coral/amber. The first conditional effect is tied ONLY to die 2; the all-hit rule is configured on die 2 and explicitly requires all attack segments to hit. It is not an unconditional per-die bonus. Do not merge these clauses or put either under die 1.
A compact "描述" section follows these cards INSIDE the same scroll viewport. The real full text is:
"先以冠形火光压住对手，再在裂纹最亮时落下裁断。"
Show its heading and the beginning of the actual text at the lower edge of the viewport, with the rest naturally below the viewport and accessible using the visible scrollbar. Do not clip either dice card's mechanical rules and do not make any letters leak over the footer. A restrained bottom fade can show continuation.
All character sizes must remain comfortably readable, with body type similar in size to Image 1, enough horizontal room and controlled line spacing. More content is handled by scrolling rather than a giant fixed-height panel or reduced text size.

Design priorities:
At a glance the player sees there are 2 dice, their distinct 3~6 and 2~4 ranges and sequential order. Every clause is inside the correct die card. The next-die effect is explicit without pretending the bonus has already triggered. Persistent dice overview, compact readable cards, thin scrollbar, fixed close controls and a separately scrollable left list when future pools overflow constitute a practical scalable design. Do not add fake extra dice to this real two-die skill. Do not insert a separate equip, confirm, start battle or use-skill action. No search or talent tree. No invented flavor text. Preserve the elegant fantasy materials and correct Chinese text. Produce a finished, balanced, implementable in-game multi-dice skill page screenshot.

Primary request: redesign the existing enemy skill popup to share the beautiful player skill page's visual components while having a SINGLE-COLUMN READ-ONLY layout. Enemies have only the current skill here, NO skill list and no selection controls.

Input roles:
Image 1 is the existing enemy skill modal screenshot, the EDIT TARGET, real content and battle-context reference. Replace its huge plain brown rectangle with the new enemy skill window. Keep the same recognizable forest ruins, swordsman, three rats, speed hexagons and red connecting curves behind a mild darkened backdrop. Top-left global "能量 10 / 10", top-center "第 1 回合", bottom "准备" control remain in their original outer scene positions.
Image 2 is the approved player skill page, a STYLE AND COMPONENT REUSE reference ONLY. Reuse its refined deep-green reading surface, thin antique gold/brass double frame, subtle wood title plaque, tiny teal gems, restrained corner ivy, coral-red attack range, warm ivory text and parchment-gold close button. Do NOT copy its left skill list, wooden sword, Chara identity, equip badges or confirm behavior.

A compact centered modal roughly 54-57 percent of screen width and 62-66 percent of screen height, below the round HUD. The new panel should be sensibly smaller than the old empty window. Its contents span the usable interior width in ONE column; do not reserve an empty left column, blank character portrait rail, equipment card or skill navigation space. The near-opaque dark forest-green panel never lets battle lines, creatures or letters bleed into the reading region. Moderate outer backdrop shade, refined soft shadow and restrained ornament.

Header:
Centered small ornate wood-and-brass title plaque exactly "敌方技能", gilded square "×" close control at the top-right.
Below, left-aligned identity "嗜血啮鼠", and a modest badge "当前技能". This is a view of this enemy's already determined skill, not a list to choose from. Omit the debugging string ID:14.
A fine gold horizontal divider.

Body:
Prominent warm ivory skill name exactly "腐齿啃咬".
Compact metadata chips on one row: "攻击", "能耗 0", "骰子数 1". These are informational only. Keep the real energy cost visible as in the existing full detail page, without implying it draws from the player's energy.
Below, a generous but compact full-width reusable DICE CARD:
Heading "第 1 攻击骰", small coral-red dice emblem, label "威力范围" and large coral-red "1 ~ 3". Separate range and clause block with a thin gold rule.
Inside this card a small clean row "词条：无". Do not invent poison, bleeding or disease effects. This actual skill has no additional effects.

"它的尖嘴中还带有模糊的血污与腐肉，最好别被碰到"
Do not paraphrase, embellish, add stats, shorten or repeat the sentence. Keep type large with generous side padding, all text fully visible. Do not turn this flavor description into gameplay effects.

Deep forest green, muted brass, warm ivory, controlled coral range and a tiny teal accent, no neon, no website or sci-fi styling.
